purpose: Teach: 一寸/やむなく/専ら/例える/かねてから/しなやか/でたらめ/おとなしい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、一寸絵を描いていい?
lines.en: Sho, is it okay if I draw a picture?
lines.style: Warm, patient opening. Slight lift at the end—asking permission genuinely, not out of obligation. Settling in beside him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、雨でやむなくお家でお絵描きしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I had to stay inside because of the rain, so I drew pictures.
lines.style: Small, matter-of-fact voice. No complaint in it—just stating what happened. Eager to share without pushing. Direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは専らお絵描きが趣味なのよ
lines.en: Sho, drawing is actually my main hobby.
lines.style: Gentle revelation, almost to herself at first. Soft smile. The kind of admission she doesn't usually make. Brief pause before speaking.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ぼくの夢をスーパーマンに例えるる話を作ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I made up a story comparing my dream to Superman!
lines.style: Sudden brightness. Bursting to tell her. Words tumble out. High energy but genuine—not performed for effect.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはかねてから翔くんに絵を教えたかったのよ
lines.en: Sho, I've actually been wanting to teach you how to draw for a long time.
lines.style: Careful sincerity. Each word chosen. A small admission of something she's held. Warm but serious—this matters to her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、しなやかな線で絵を描きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to draw with graceful, flowing lines.
lines.style: Thoughtful. He's imagining it as he speaks. Whisper-soft, almost dreaming aloud. No rush—he's thinking with her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、でたらめなお話を作らないでね
lines.en: Sho, don't make up random stories for me, okay?
lines.style: Gentle boundary. Not stern—caring. The tone of someone redirecting, not scolding. A small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、おとなしい妹欲しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I wish I had a quiet little sister like you.
lines.style: Sudden vulnerable whisper. A child saying something he's been thinking alone. Tenderness, a little shyness. Almost surprised by his own honesty.
